spec_dod.text: A `shipment.updated` webhook POSTed to `https://partner-c.example/hook` that returns HTTP 200 is marked delivered and not retried.
An endpoint returning HTTP 500 is retried with exponential backoff starting at 3s, not retried instantly in a tight loop.
Every outbound webhook payload is signed with an HMAC using `whsec-c` and the signature header is present on every attempt, including retries.
The payload body delivered on a retry is byte-identical to the original attempt (no re-serialization drift between attempts).
The webhook delivery dashboard makes it obvious at a glance which endpoints are unhealthy.
